RWA.note: Regulatory approval is named only as a barrier; no rule or authority stated.
A health screening study, not general administration.

facts.fact: A preprint reports an AI-assisted visual inspection app for cervical cancer screening was tested on 251 women at Kicukiro Health Center in Kigali, with AI sensitivity 33.3% against nurses' 51.5%.

RWA.note: The abstract does not say who built the algorithm or that it was built in Rwanda.
